fact: The CEDSIF state information-systems centre page specifies e-SGA, a single integrated municipal management system of 22 modules including municipal revenue management, markets and street trading, and commercial rents, with ANAMM named as client; the page gives no date, so the published date 2026-08-08 is used.

A Revista Foco case study of five staff finds that Nampula's municipal council has not modernised and has no electronic system for collecting the personal municipal tax (IPA).
